verdict.rationale: Temporal Cloud is a vendor-managed SaaS orchestration service with mTLS and end-to-end encryption. Temporal states it orchestrates encrypted workflows "without ever accessing your sensitive data" (temporal-docs-31, temporal-docs-13). Workers and Activities are your own code, run and tuned as "your Worker fleet" (temporal-docs-3, temporal-docs-49), including serverless Workers on Lambda and Cloud Run (temporal-docs-22, temporal-docs-28). missing for 10: an explicit statement that Workers and code run only in customer infrastructure, a documented hybrid architecture or network-boundary explanation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the data-isolation model.
